parsedVerdict.reasoning: WorkshopController sits in the presentation layer. Most of its methods do what that layer should: they hand the call to the injected business services (MaintenanceService, MileageService) and format the result with workOrderJson. openOrder is the exception. It checks `input.estimatedHours <= 0 || input.estimatedHours > 40` itself and throws a FleetError. The rule that a work-order estimate must be above 0 and at most 40 hours is a business policy (a maximum estimate for a work order). It is not just a check on the shape of the input, so the business layer (MaintenanceService.open or the WorkOrder model) should own it. Both candidate flags point to this method, and the source confirms them. The rest of the file is acceptable: the constructor parameters are injected business services, and the input interfaces belong in a presentation file.
